Spec §4 Tech View restrictions table says 'Cannot view labor rates — Labor rate columns and fields are hidden on work order lines.' But SV-8107 ('Tech view exposes WO-line labor rate when See Financial is ON') was closed OBSOLETE / not-a-bug (2026-07-13) with NO explicit PO statement — implying labor rate IS visible in Tech View when SFD is ON. This case (viu=Deviation) observed labor rate NOT hidden, matching SV-8107 and contradicting spec §4. Confirm with the PO whether spec §4 governs (rate hidden) or SV-8107 governs (rate visible with SFD ON), then rewrite or keep accordingly. Do not push until resolved.
reason: Direct spec §4 vs SV-8107 contradiction with no explicit PO ruling; recorded Deviation. Standing Rule 15 — flag, don't pick a side.

proposed_text.title: The AP/AR cross-cutting toggle is labeled 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable'
proposed_text.custom_expected:
The Cross-Cutting Toggles card shows a toggle labeled 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable'. It sits alongside the 'See Financial Data' toggle in the same card. (Part History visibility is now the 'View Part History' setting under the Parts group, no longer a cross-cutting toggle.) When ON, it controls the Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs on customers and vendors, and the sensitive money fields on Edit Customer.

NOTE (confirm live): the build may still show the legacy labels 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' / 'View History Logs' until SV-8202 ships — see LABEL-BATCH.md.

reason: This case's whole purpose is to assert the toggle LABEL, and it asserts the two stale labels: AP/AR renamed to 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable' (6/10) and 'View History Logs' relabelled to 'View Part History' and moved out of the cross-cutting card into the Parts group (7/7). Highest-priority label case.
